versions.content: Behavior of Dem_ResetEventStatus The function Dem_Re- setEventStatus shall set the event status bit 0 (TestFailed) to 0 and reset the Dem-internal debounce algorithm to initial values if configured. The Dem shall execute this action asynchronously at a later point in time.
